name: expiry_seller_v3
kind: forward paper test (no orders): every trade is decided by the rules below before its outcome exists
question: law L1 (the expiry-eve premium) replicated on instruments it was never fitted to (expiry_eve_law_v1: pooled t 4.46; FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY and SENSEX qualified individually). Does it survive their real bid/ask going forward, naked and insured?

history.source: expiry_eve_law_v1 (spec 51e180594091), Study run 37170766466: docs/prereg/results/expiry_eve_law_v1-51e180594091.md; NSE and BSE F&O bhavcopy, evidence class real_eod_approximation
history.convention: as expiry_seller_v1; rupees per lot at the reference lot below (the median lot of each instrument's history), so forward and history compare like for like whatever the exchange's current lot
history.caveats: FINNIFTY and MIDCPNIFTY moved from weekly to monthly expiries in Nov 2024 (about 12 forward trades a year each); SENSEX history starts in 2024 (BSE's archive); 43 configurations tried across the earlier studies, but these instruments were held out of all of them

E.risk: defined: the law with crash insurance

size: 1 reference lot per sleeve per underlying; P&L in rupees per reference lot
entry: exactly as expiry_seller_v1: the chain tape's snapshot nearest 15:20 within 15:10-15:25 on the eve, real quotes only, out-of-the-money strikes nearest each delta within 0.08, a two-sided quote on every leg, sells at bid - 0.05, buys at ask + 0.05, statutory fees
exit: as expiry_seller_v1, with one more source: these indices have no recorded minute bars, so the 15:00-15:29 mean of the index spot the chain tape logged every minute (the index's own Kotak quote) stands before Yahoo's close; the source is recorded
rules: as expiry_seller_v1: the cost check from 6 settled trades, the consistency check from 8, the naked tail rule (1.5 x the history's worst), a retired sleeve opens nothing more
eligibility: as expiry_seller_v1: reported, never applied; E (defined risk) first; D only after E has been eligible for 3 months on that underlying; real money only on the owner's word
changes: any change is a new spec with its own ledger; this ledger is never edited
